purpose: Functional contract for the subset of operations selected from the previous Gravita Rust Core Bus for the lighter Gravita product.
selection_policy: Includes only operations required by the current Gravita product scope: document persistence, relief modeling, imported machining geometry and meshes, tool management, CAM, simulation, safety and G-code. Interactive vector authoring, bitmap editing, UI/dialog/window commands and unrelated workbenches are excluded.
parameter_policy: Parameter names and JSON value types are derived from the actual Rust Core Bus handler branches. Optionality and defaults are recorded only where established by the handler; source_expression preserves the extraction evidence for review.
